scoring_justification: Recomputing the DFT/NEB total energies in the verifier is infeasible; scoring verifies mandatory structural trends and compares reported values to paper gold with generous tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold: paper-reported defect formation energies and NEB barriers with tolerances, plus expected trends.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 1 and text: edge‑shared ~390 meV, corner‑shared ~490 meV; Li‑deficient ~100–200 meV; NEB barriers ~1.4 eV (without electron) and ~0.8 eV (with electron). Exact reference values taken from solve.sh which match the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper’s reported results; tolerances chosen to allow systematic offsets between VASP and open‑source DFT.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s published computational results.

outputs.description: Defect formation energies for the corner-shared and edge-shared Li/Fe anti-site configurations in stoichiometric and Li-deficient LiFePO4, along with reference defect-free total energies.
NEB activation barriers for recombination without and with an extra electron, plus the discretized energy profiles along the reaction coordinate.

output_contract.notes: Formation energies and NEB barriers are compared to the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances. Trend checks (Li-deficient energies lower than stoichiometric; NEB barrier with electron lower than without) are also applied.

steps.description: Check formation energy trends and numerical consistency with paper's reference values.
Check NEB barrier trend (with electron lower) and values within tolerance of paper's reference.
